extra_issues.title: Distance-keyed map-layer levels can flip at rest after any landscape pan: panEnd's anchor() changes viewDist without moving the picture
extra_issues.evidence: app.js:6498 panEnd -> anchor() app.js:6481-6482 slides the orbit target along its view ray to the drawn ground; measured +9.9 units (243.67 -> 253.6) after a 270 px pan from the Field vantage (docs/audit-post8-evidence/verification/v-batch-visual/pan-and-stream.json). viewDist also keys showBde (dist<165, app.js:6094), so the brigade level can flip the same way.
extra_issues.notes: Generalises visual-maps #11 beyond the Field preset; the brigade case is inferred from the code, not measured. Inherited (0a19964).
